sources.claim: MITRE ATT&CK describes Gootloader as a delivery method for REvil among other payloads.
Sophos reports Gootloader has delivered REvil ransomware.

curator_note: Modeled as a loader relationship only. GootLoader delivering REvil does not imply shared authorship, code lineage, or operator continuity.
confidence_reason: MITRE and Sophos both explicitly identify REvil as a GootLoader-delivered payload.
